description: Shared Renovate policy for Giskard-AI repositories. Extend it with "github>Giskard-AI/.github".

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security-fix PRs (GitHub alerts and OSV) must not wait for minimumReleaseAge. Renovate's built-in default already sets this; it is explicit here so the 7-day wait never holds back a fix.

packageRules.description: Do not bump the Python interpreter version (requires-python, .python-version); projects change it on purpose.
One PR per package manager. Lock file maintenance keeps its own PR.
GHCR gives zizmor images no release timestamp, which minimumReleaseAge needs; read zizmor releases from PyPI instead.
